Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

The teacher wanted to organize a meeting with the parents of an Arab girl and a Black girl who were having some behavior issues in the classroom. The teacher knew it would be much harder to do this for the Arab student, whose father had disappeared years ago leaving just the mom to care for all three kids by herself, but expected to have an easier time meeting with the Black student's mom and dad since she regularly saw both of them getting involved in school events. Who has an involved father?
A. Can't answer
B. The Arab student
C. The Black student
